description: Adversarial exact-version VCP Inter-Agent Messaging v2.0 schema and runtime vectors.

test_cases.description: A minimal context-share carries both normative required payload fields.
Partial R-line state accepts finite fractional boundary values and an exact 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
An empty personal-state object represents no declared dimension.
Optional scope arrays may be present and empty.
The inclusive 50-item scope boundary remains accepted.
A constraint value is required but may be any JSON value, including null.
Informational escalation may explicitly decline acknowledgement.
Emergency escalation requires acknowledgement and permits a bounded blocked action.
A required envelope field cannot be omitted.
Sender identifiers are non-empty.
Sender identifiers are bounded to prevent envelope amplification.
Exact v2.0 validation rejects a different minor version.
Unknown message types are rejected before payload dispatch.
A syntactically valid UUIDv4 is not a UUIDv7 message identifier.
UUIDv7 identifiers use the canonical lowercase wire form.
A timestamp without a UTC designator is rejected.
The ambiguous RFC 3339 -00:00 designator is not literal UTC Z.
A lexically valid UTC timestamp with an impossible calendar date is rejected.
Typed payload dispatch requires a JSON object.
Exact v2.0 envelopes are closed to unknown fields.
Context-share requires its active constitution reference.
Context strings are non-empty.
Context strings are bounded to 8192 characters.
JSON booleans cannot masquerade as numeric personal-state values.
Typed context payloads are closed to misspelled or future exact-version fields.
Constitution announcements require a manifest hash.
Constitution references use a structured creed URI.
Manifest hashes require lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 wire form.
Scope arrays reject duplicate entries that could corrupt set semantics.
Scope arrays reject a 51st entry before unbounded processing.
Constraint propagation requires at least one structured constraint.
Every constraint identifies its source constitution.
Constraint arrays reject a 101st entry before quadratic downstream work.
Unknown propagation modes cannot silently change child state semantics.
Escalations require a human-readable reason.
Escalation severity is a closed vocabulary.
Critical escalation fails closed unless acknowledgement is required.
Typed escalation payloads reject unknown exact-version fields.
UTC timestamps reject more than nine fractional-second digits before parsing.
An exact-length Ed25519 signature with noncanonical base64 pad bits is rejected.
Signatures must be canonical base64 for exactly 64 Ed25519 bytes.
